instruction: Add Firefox to the favorite applications list

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding Firefox to the existing favorites ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']. Evaluator verifies the list contains all 4 apps using check_gnome_favorite_apps which checks if the set of apps matches (order-independent).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts favorite apps list using gsettings command
Metric function properly handles expected parameter (accesses rule['expected'] directly, not rule.get('rules'))
Set-based comparison is semantically appropriate since order of favorites doesn't matter
Length check prevents false positives (e.g., if Firefox added but another app removed)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the full requirement (Firefox added to existing list)
Expected value is correct: contains all 4 apps including newly added firefox.desktop
No postconfig needed: system settings are persistent, no UI state to reopen
